title: Smart Value
description: smartvalue.biz zoominfo.com/c/smart-value/408286294 Smart Value Limited is an Indian MLM (multi-level marketing) / network marketing company founded in 2003–2004 in New Delhi by Manoj Kumar Gupta, operating 100+ offices across India with a claimed 2,000,000+ distributors (IBAs). The company sells health supplements, personal care, household products, and educational courses — but revenue is not publicly disclosed (private MLM). Its core business model relies on recruiting new distributors rather than actual retail sales, with heavily inflated product pricing (200–500% above market) to fund multi-level commissions. The company faces serious and widespread allegations: consumer complaints about pyramid-like structure, inability to recover investments, fake income claims on social media, and reported law enforcement scrutiny in India. ~99% of participants lose money (standard MLM economics), while only top recruitment leaders profit.
